case_title: LAKHAN SINGH v. AMARJEET SINGH & ANR.
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under s.302 IPC, sentenced to life imprisonment with fine of Rs.1 lakh
neutral_facts: The accused-applicant, who was previously found fit to face trial, sought to introduce additional evidence regarding his mental condition at the time of the incident. The Trial Court had already examined medical reports and found him fit to stand trial. The High Court allowed the application for additional evidence, but the Supreme Court set aside the High Court's order, stating that the High Court should have examined the existing record before allowing further evidence. The case was remanded for reconsideration by the High Court.
